stages.name: Resolve next available source after Seg20
Prepare hidden Seg22
stages.detail: Seg22 is present in the timeline (30 frames) and vehiclePath (30 points) but absent from map.trajectory, so applyProgressiveFrozenAppend finds no Seg22 chunk.

stages.name: Rollback decision
stages.oldBehaviour: The optional Seg22 preparation failure propagated out of progressiveRevealPrepared into progressiveAppendNext, whose catch restored the prior snapshot -> rolled back to Seg19.
stages.newBehaviour: The optional preparation is wrapped in its own try/catch; Seg20 stays committed; only hiddenLookahead is cleared; the failed source is reported.
stages.result: old = rollback-scope bug; new = retain committed Seg20

stages.name: Restore prior snapshot
stages.oldBehaviour: restoreProgressiveStateSnapshot(prefixSnapshotKey([Seg19])) restored Seg19 exactly (removing the committed Seg20).
